operating_notes.text: The company operates in a single segment, so no segmental reporting applies.
Inventories of ₹50.77 Cr at March 2026 were nearly half of total assets of ₹112.17 Cr.
NSE fined the company ₹70,000 plus ₹12,600 GST for a Regulation 17(1) board-composition breach in the quarter ended March 31, 2026; a sixth director was appointed with effect from May 21, 2026.
FY26 revenue ₹234.20 Cr against raw material consumption of ₹203.36 Cr; the company operates in a single segment.
FY26 operating cash flow was ₹6.22 Cr against PBT of ₹7.01 Cr, with inventory up ₹14.95 Cr and receivables up ₹9.63 Cr.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026, Madhav Copper reported that its postal ballot special resolution to change the company's name passed with 99.9956% of votes cast in favour.
M TEK COPPER LIMITED (formerly Madhav Copper Limited) changed its name with ROC approval effective May 05, 2026, signed by CS Sneha Langaliya.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹84.06 Cr, net profit ₹2.91 Cr (+69.2% YoY).

On 28 May 2026, M TEK Copper disclosed an NSE notice dated 27 May 2026 fining it ₹70,000 plus ₹12,600 GST for a Regulation 17(1) board-composition breach in Q4FY26, saying a sixth director was appointed on 21 May 2026.
Madhav Copper Limited’s name changed to M TEK COPPER LIMITED effective June 09, 2026, as per Manager Jeetendra Rangnani’s circular.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹84.06 Cr; FY26 revenue ₹234.20 Cr; PAT ₹4.49 Cr.
Company changed name from *Madhav Copper Limited* to *M TEK COPPER LIMITED* on NSE records, effective June 09, 2026, per approval under SEBI LODR.
M TEK COPPER fined ₹11,800 by NSE on October 14, 2026 for late XBRL filing
